description: Bosch BMP388 — high-performance digital barometric pressure sensor, 300-1250 hPa, ±0.5 hPa relative accuracy, I2C/SPI. LGA-10 package. Successor to BMP280 with better noise performance.
name: bmp388
watch_out_for: LGA-10: reflow only. 1.8-3.6V; CSB/SDO select SPI vs I2C and address; the vent hole must stay uncovered.
